summary: Fresh critic on the shadow/fog/shader-chunk round. Did not build it. R1 is confirmed by a rendered A/B that could have overturned it: at HEAD the Blackwood vista reaches 95% fog at 912 m; with installAerialPerspective() re-enabled on a control clone the SAME camera reaches it at 48 m. The chunk owner is read out of the page in both arms, so neither arm asserts the disputed input. Separately: the hardware frame-time budget contains two pairs of BYTE-IDENTICAL arms the builder did not notice it had, which measure the run's own repeatability at up to 1.59 ms — six times the canopy cost it is being used to price. And the Deep Marshes bands are not shadows at all: high-passed and cross-correlated they are 0.84 self-similar between 08:00 and 13:00 and 0.67 against 19:30, against 0.046 for the negative control.
findings_so_far: R1 CONFIRMED, and by an arm that could have failed. HEAD: fog_fragment owned by render/sky.js, uAerial not declared, 95% fog at 912 m (blackwood) / 1414 m (deep-marshes) / 1726 m (salt-hills). Control clone with the one line uncommented: fog_fragment owned by world/aerial.js, uAerial declared, 95% fog at 48 m at the same camera. tools/visual/w1-30-fog-owner-ab.mjs.

THE COMMENTED PATH IS DEAD, confirmed at runtime not by grep: installAerialPerspective() has exactly one import site (province.js:15) and one call site (commented, line 144); the live page reports uAerial_declared=false, so THREE.ShaderLib was never touched either.

SWEEP: exactly two module-scope THREE.ShaderChunk patchers in game/src (aerial.js, sky.js). But the PATTERN has a second, larger and older instance: Material.copy() in three r180 does NOT copy onBeforeCompile and DOES deep-copy userData, so every .clone() of a worldMaterial silently drops installSurfaceShader's detail-normal/wear/wetness pass while keeping userData.surfaceUniforms — 305 of 406 materials in the running scene are in that state, including the player's own body. Mechanism arm run in the page: source hook installs surface = true, clone hook installs surface = false, clone keeps surfaceUniforms = true. NOT this round's defect and NOT this round's file.

THE BUDGET'S ARMS ARE NOT SIX, THEY ARE FOUR. w1-30-shadow-casters.mjs's applyArm() only ever turns flags ON, so once the terrain and geology flags landed in source, `base` == `terrain` and `terrain+canopy` == `terrain+canopy+geology` — byte-identical caster configurations with identical casterTriangles. Same-configuration medians differ by up to 1.59 ms (salt-hills) and 1.23 ms (spawn). The canopy delta being priced is 0.25-0.60 ms. The ruling holds and is now better evidenced than the builder knew; F3's 'terrain alone 0.009%' is vacuous (cast+0) and F2's headline sentence crosses two sites.

THE BANDS ARE NOT SHADOWS. Offline cross-correlation of the committed hardware stills over a fixed band-rich crop: rho(t0800,t1300)=0.844, rho(t0800,t1930)=0.666, rho(t1300,t1930)=0.689, negative control (same crop, blackwood) 0.046, rain vs clear 0.896. A sun-driven pattern cannot be that self-similar across a day.
